stem: A CI job at Wrenfield Software should fail the build whenever a file is not canonically formatted, but it must never rewrite a contributor's files. Which command fits?

choices.text: run with no extra flag, letting it rewrite the file directly

rationale: -check reports formatting status through its exit code without rewriting any file, which is exactly what a build gate that must not modify files needs. Running with no flag rewrites files directly, the opposite of the requirement. validate checks correctness rather than style and would not catch a formatting mismatch at all. -recursive changes the scope of directories covered, not whether files get rewritten.
